verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is an open-source CLI tool (installable via Homebrew, Docker, or Go) that runs entirely locally/self-hosted, scanning git repos, directories, or stdin without requiring any external service; the GitHub Action is an optional CI integration, not a mandatory hosted dependency. Missing for 10: no explicit statement of license or self-hosted deployment guarantees, and no independent audit confirming no telemetry/phone-home behavior.
